_disclaimer: 45 trades over 17 months is insufficient for statistical significance on Sharpe.
Standard error on Sharpe with N=45 is ~±0.54, so the true range is roughly 1.3–2.3.
The rigorous number is the walk-forward OOS accuracy: 63.3% mean (p=0.0009).
Do not use these results for marketing. Run 90+ days of live paper trading first.
Sharpe was previously reported as 5.637 — that figure was incorrect (annualisation error).
sharpe_note: Trade-level Sharpe: mean(net_pnl)/std(net_pnl)*sqrt(252/avg_hold_days=9.4). N=45 — not statistically robust.
